audit: Phase 8.1 Independent Confirmation Data Availability Audit

audited_datasets.overlap_audit: 100% of TORGO utterances were utilized in Phase 8 and Phase 8.1 development/diagnostics.
audited_datasets.disqualification_rationale: The 1,215 locked test partition was inspected across multiple Phase 8 audits and reporting cycles; it is contaminated for confirmation and restricted to diagnostic-only.

other_repository_data_search.findings: No secondary, prospective, or uninspected atypical speech dataset exists in the repository.

phase_8_2_readiness_plan.step_1: Acquire or collect a prospective, consented atypical speech dataset with independent speakers and verified audio provenance.
phase_8_2_readiness_plan.step_2: Verify zero sample, speaker, and session overlap with the TORGO corpus.
phase_8_2_readiness_plan.step_3: Validate sufficient emergency-class support across clinical emergency intents.
phase_8_2_readiness_plan.step_4: Pre-register and freeze exact model checkpoints, thresholds, metric definitions, and acceptance criteria.
phase_8_2_readiness_plan.step_5: Execute a single-shot confirmation evaluation without post-hoc threshold adjustment.
